title: No stable single-command local production launcher
why_it_matters: User must understand backend/frontend internals to start the app.
recommended_fix: Add CLI command such as hb-assistant analytics serve --open.

title: Production frontend static serving not guaranteed
why_it_matters: A local production shortcut should not depend on Vite dev server.
recommended_fix: Serve frontend/dist from FastAPI or approved static server.

title: No repo-managed desktop shortcut script
why_it_matters: User wants desktop shortcut without maintaining raw terminal commands.
recommended_fix: Add scripts/local/launch_hb_dashboard.command that calls stable CLI.

title: Port/process conflict behavior not specified
why_it_matters: Duplicate launches can create confusing failures.
recommended_fix: Detect occupied port and existing dashboard instance.

title: Launcher logs and troubleshooting not formalized
why_it_matters: Failures need actionable messages for non-engineering use.

title: No explicit future executable packaging decision
why_it_matters: Shortcut and executable packaging are separate implementation tracks.
recommended_fix: Document that executable packaging is deferred pending launcher stability.
